text:
maria: Quick sync — Snowflake + Qdrant partner asked for a 90-min integration window next Tue 9am PT. Can we confirm infra + data readiness? @aj @liam

aj: Works for PM. We need a concise acceptance checklist: schema mapping, sample 10k rows, telemetry contract, network peering, IAM creds rotation.

liam: Eng can make the time but will need staging GPU nodes warmed and the vector index prebuilt. Who will own preparing the sample dataset? @qdrant_ops

qdrant_ops: We can supply an anonymized 10k rows CSV and an export script. Will upload the file and a small README by EOD.

emily: Also note marketing/partner comms: we need marketplace listing artifacts (logo + 1-liner), and a short test plan for the announcement page. I can draft once validation passes.

maria: Draft acceptance criteria I'm proposing: 
- Data ingest success (10k rows) <15m
- Embedding/insert latency p99 <200ms on staging
- KV/cache warmup <1m for repeat requests
- Telemetry surface: token-level cost + error traces visible in the Console
- Listing assets ready (logos + 1-pager)

samir: For networking/ops — plan to use temporary VPC peering and an STS role for cross-account pulls. Need partner CIDR and contact for firewall rules. Quick ops snippets: 
```
# AWS peering (example)
aws ec2 create-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-id vpc-abc --peer-vpc-id vpc-partner
# GCP firewall allow for qdrant API
gcloud compute firewall-rules create allow-qdrant --allow tcp:8000
```

liam: Also add a test for the quantized model variant (8-bit) and a fallback routing policy if we hit throughput throttles (route to smaller model).

aj: Good call. Who will own rollback policy + canary percentage? I propose 10% canary with 30m soak, automatic rollback on error rate >2%.

maria: I'll own rollback/canary config and update the rollout doc. @marketing hold announcements until we have green validation.

marketing: Noted — will prepare teaser assets but hold publish until final sign-off and legal OK.

qdrant_ops: Uploaded sample and script: https://files.qdrant.dev/sample/sf-qdrant-10k.csv and README in same folder. Ping if access issues.

maria: Awesome. Next steps summary: liam to provision staging nodes by Mon EOD, qdrant to upload sample today (confirmed), aj to finalize checklist doc and circulate, emily to stage marketing draft but hold publish. Meeting invite sent for Tue 9am PT. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

aj: Invite accepted. I'll post the final checklist in #partnerships and tag the ops runbook.

maria: Thanks all — aiming for a smooth partner dry-run and then a coordinated listing.
